# Golden Bay Technologies (GBTech)

IT support, Microsoft workplace, security & compliance, and owned websites with custom booking for Tākaka, Golden Bay, Nelson/Tasman and beyond. Local since 2014 — structural diagnostics, same-day remote fixes, no subscription SaaS landlord.

Site: https://gbtech.co.nz/
Contact: Warwick Marshall · warwick.marshall@gmail.com · +64 27 814 2222

## Primary pages

- https://gbtech.co.nz/ — Homepage: computer repair & IT support from Tākaka; service hubs, packages, live portfolio, and contact
- https://gbtech.co.nz/#portfolio — Live client sites and business systems (e.g. Unlimited Copies Takaka, Site Machinery, Gold Standard Dog Training)
- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/it.html — IT Support hub: day-to-day support, servers/networks, backup & recovery
- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/web-digital.html — Web & Digital hub: owned sites, booking portals, leave Wix/Squarespace
- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/microsoft-workplace.html — Microsoft Cloud Workplace hub: Microsoft 365, PowerApps, mobile apps
- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/security-compliance.html — Security & Compliance hub: cyber security and cloud migration

## High-intent services

- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/it-support.html — Computer repair and day-to-day IT support for Tākaka, Golden Bay, Nelson & beyond
- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/essential-website.html — Essential Site ($351): be found, mobile-ready, owned code, zero rent — GBP setup, free hosting, crawler-ready for Google, Bing, and AI
- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/booking-portal.html — Advanced Booking ($702): Essential + Google Calendar sync, spot caps, memberships; crawler-ready SEO; zero monthly hosting rent
- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/wix-migration.html — Migrate off Wix or Squarespace to an owned GBTech site
- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/automation-ai.html — Custom Systems & Apps: multi-user portals, Firestore, Dataverse, staff scheduling, complex workflows. Scoped as projects ($117–$127/hr), separately from Essential and Advanced packages. Firestore is more complex than package work and lives here.
- https://gbtech.co.nz/services/cyber-security.html — Cyber security and insurance-aligned hardening for small businesses
